prompt:
Fantasy trading-card illustration in the style of early-to-mid 1990s card art: hand-made traditional media (gouache, acrylic, watercolour and pen-and-ink), visible brushstrokes and pen lines, matte paper texture, and the slightly soft, faded look of a card printed in the 1990s. Expressive and a little stylised rather than realistic: strong shapes, bold silhouettes, sometimes inked outlines and flat patterned colour. Dark overall with near-black shadows, lit by bold, saturated accent colours (ember orange, deep violet, sea teal, blood red) where they matter. Frame the subject tightly: it fills most of the picture and may be cropped by the edges, with its face or focal point near the centre; keep the background minimal, simple and dark. Landscape 3:2 composition. No text, no letters, no border, no card frame, no logo, no watermark, no signature. Not photorealistic, not 3D render, not modern digital concept art, not anime.

Setting: Greek myth as told in Homer, Hesiod and the Greek tragedies, depicted faithfully to those stories: bronze armour, crested helmets, round aspis shields, linen chitons, black ships, the wine-dark Aegean sea, white limestone, temples, cypress, smoke and fire.

Subject: A Siren of Anthemoessa, the flowery island of the Sirens: a bird-woman with great wings spread, singing among flowers above the sea, Odysseus's ship far below.

Composition: a close-up of the Siren's face and her great spread wings, mouth open in song. Light and colour: dawn rose and pale gold. Presence: a dangerous but ordinary foe. The subject fills most of the picture; keep the background minimal.
